install_python_circos: run python setup.py install to install the python-circos package locally
setup_python_circos_package: configure the python-circos package with matplotlib and biopython dependencies via setuptools
check_python_version: run setup.py to verify python version is at least 3.7 before installation
build_python_circos: run python setup.py sdist to build a source distribution of python-circos
review_setup_metadata: review the setup.py metadata including version 0.3.0 and GPLv3 license for python-circos
